title: Lantern Ledger: publish after the payment transaction
body: The author says moving publish prevents notifications for failed commits and makes payment and notification atomic.
contracts: transaction invokes the callback once and commits its staged writes only after callback fulfillment. It fulfills with undefined after commit. Callback or commit rejection rolls back all staged writes.
publish is an external operation outside the database transaction. Its rejection may happen before or after an externally visible notification.
markPaid is idempotent for a given id. Neither transaction nor publish supplies a delivery deduplication guarantee.
A process can stop between awaited operations. No durable outbox, background retry, or cross-call lock is supplied.
